Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 35

“The great chariot-warriors will think you withdrew from the battle out of fear, and you, who were highly regarded by them, will be held lightly.”

Krishna names the specific audience — the very warriors Arjuna respects. Not abstract public opinion but the judgement of peers, which is what actually stings a soldier.
